data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that wraps the Agora RTC SDK for real‑time audio/video calls and live streaming.
data.what_it_does: It exposes Agora's native RTC APIs to Flutter, letting you start and manage voice/video sessions on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and (alpha) web. The package handles platform channel communication and provides Dart wrappers for the native SDK features.
use_when: You need low‑latency, high‑quality real‑time voice or video communication across multiple platforms.
You want to leverage Agora's cloud services and advanced RTC features (e.g., custom audio/video processing).
avoid_when: You require a pure‑Dart solution without native SDK dependencies.
You only target web and need full feature parity (the web support is still alpha).
strengths: Official Agora support and frequent updates.
Cross‑platform coverage including desktop and mobile.
Access to the full native SDK feature set via Flutter.
weaknesses: Requires native SDK setup and platform‑specific permissions.
Web implementation is alpha and limited.
Binary size increase due to native libraries.
data.setup_notes: Add Android permissions (camera, microphone, etc.) in AndroidManifest.xml, iOS/macOS privacy keys in Info.plist, and include the iris‑web‑rtc JS script in web/index.html. Follow Agora's native SDK integration docs for each platform.
